reference.citation: Kim J, Cho J, Lee MH, et al. Blood. 2024;144(6):629-638.
reference.title: CAR T cells vs bispecific antibody as third- or later-line large B-cell lymphoma therapy: a meta-analysis.
reference.notes: Single-arm pooled proportions (bispecific antibody arm); random-effects model. Published CR 0.36 (95% CI 0.29-0.43); CAR-T naive bispecific subset CR 0.37 (0.32-0.43). ORR pooled separately per study; reference paper focus is CR as primary outcome. I2 not reported per subgroup in abstract.

caveats: DRAFT ANSWER KEY — human-verify against Kim 2024 full text (PMID 38696731, DOI 10.1182/blood.2023023419) before sealing.
Published CR extracted from abstract: 0.36 (95% CI 0.29-0.43) for bispecific antibody group; converted to percent (36%, 29-43%).
ORR not pooled in abstract for BsAb arm specifically; estimate left null (not_scored).
I2 not reported per subgroup in abstract; set to null.
k=16 studies (bispecific antibody trials), n=1347 total (both arms) in reference.
group=ALL because subgroup_field is empty (single bispecific antibody class, no stratification).
